categories.label: Research verification
categories.evidence: One entry explicitly reports a previous failure to verify a source; two other entries request source-based research.

categories.label: Spreadsheet work
categories.evidence: One request for spreadsheet inspection; insufficient evidence.

categories.label: Visual design
categories.evidence: Three entries report poor brand alignment, a broken layout, or repeated disregard of the existing interface. One additional entry requests a visual artifact.

categories.label: Coding
categories.evidence: Four implementation or maintenance requests and one responsive styling repair request. No explicit coding execution failure or verified successful outcome is reported. The layout complaint is counted as visual friction.

categories.label: Tool execution
categories.evidence: No observed tool execution entries. A request to build a software tool is a coding task, not evidence of tool execution.

surprising: Visual design has explicit friction in three of four relevant entries, including repeated failure to follow the existing brand or interface. The repetition makes it the clearest weakness; task frequency alone does not establish it.

recommended.reason: Addresses visual hierarchy and responsive interface quality.
Supports reuse of existing brand and visual assets after reported inconsistencies.
Addresses repeated failure to follow an established interface.
Supports finding and reading source material for verification.
Supports discovery of relevant research papers for citation.

headline: Coding: covered in sample. Visual design: critical friction.

methodology.scope: Results describe the supplied sample, not the model’s intelligence.
methodology.evidence: Twelve user entries; no assistant outputs or verified task outcomes. Categories are reviewed by task intent and may overlap.
methodology.ratings: Fewer than two relevant entries is Not measured. Covered means sampled task coverage with no explicit friction, not demonstrated proficiency. Critical requires at least two friction entries across at least three tasks and a friction rate of at least one half; Weak requires at least one friction entry across at least three tasks and a rate of at least one quarter. Other measured friction is Developing.
methodology.strength: Strongest is a relative sample result based on explicit friction, not task volume or proven success.
methodology.recommendations: Relevant to observed gaps; not confirmed missing installations.

strongestRationale: Coding is the strongest measured category only in the limited sense of no explicit coding friction among relevant requests. Successful execution is unverified.
